title: Core mechanic 3 - Apunta (Aim & Fire)
description: Third core mechanic. Aim with the stick at a target shape and press the action button to hit it. Pure C# aim/hit logic; simple-shape prefab; MicrogameDefinition asset. Follows unity-microgame-framework skill.
acceptance_criteria: The stick controls an aim direction/reticle (simple shape); pressing the action button fires.
Win condition: hit the target within the time limit; loss otherwise. Aim-to-hit evaluation is unit-tested in pure C# (e.g. angle/position tolerance).
A MicrogameDefinition asset registers it (verb e.g. '¡APUNTA!') and it runs through the sequencer.
